home.text: A heavyweight essential engineered for comfort, structure and everyday movement.
Most hoodies are either comfortableorwell-structured. We wanted both.

We believe everyday clothing shouldn't feel ordinary. The Signature Hoodie is built with a structured heavyweight fabric, refined oversized fit, and reinforced construction—designed to outlast the moment.
① Heavyweight fabric② Reinforced seams③ Structured hood④ Drawstrings⑤ Ribbed cuffs⑥ Pocket⑦ Embroidered logo
"Best hoodie I've ever owned. The weight is perfect."
"Incredible quality and the fit is exactly what I wanted."
"Almost perfect. The fabric is premium, will buy again."
We recommend ordering your usual size. The hoodie has a refined oversized fit—size down for a slimmer look.
Yes, it's designed with a relaxed, structured oversized fit that still feels tailored.
What material is it made from?
Heavyweight 100% structured cotton blend, 450gsm for durability and comfort.
Machine wash cold inside out, hang dry to maintain structure and color.
Standard shipping 3-5 business days. Express available at checkout.
30-day hassle-free returns on unworn items with tags.
We'd love to hear from you.
Have questions about sizing, shipping, or just want to say hello? Reach out anytime.
